snippet.title: Smasher - Official Announcement Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get a look at action-packed gameplay from Smasher in this announcement trailer for the upcoming VR arcade shooter game. Try various weapons, throw them at enemies, and experience two game modes, including an endless roguelike mode and a cinematic picture featuring shootouts and more. Smasher will be available on Steam on August 21, 2025, and on Meta Quest in Q3 2025.
